tei:div.tei:p: 'jam dbyangs shes rab blo 'phel rmongs pa sel byed 'dod gsol smon lam ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang 'jam dpal yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin rlabs/ nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyi shes rab/ so so skye bo'i nus pa/ bka' sdod kyi lung*/ rin chen thams cad kyi bcud/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍita thams cad kyi shes rab/ mkhas pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi nus pa/ rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyi bcud/ nyi zla'i 'od zer/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu rin po che'i mdzod/ klu dang gnod sbyin rnams kyi shes rab dang nus stobs/ rgyal po dang bla dpon rnams kyi sems la sogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag sgrub pa po che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas zab pa dang rgya che ba dang*/ rno zhing myur ba'i shes rab phun sum 50)tshogs par gyur cig khyed kyi mkhyen brtse'i ye shes kyis bdag sogs 'gro blo'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ gzungs dang spob pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ ༈ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gi gang thob pa// des ni skye bo thams cad kyi// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog/ padma ma ṇis sbyar ba'o//
